vulnerability_summary: Zeptoclaw shell validation allowed strict-allowlist command chaining, empty-list fail-open behavior, literal-path glob bypasses, and scripting-runtime flag permutations.
causality: Three atomic Claude-coauthored commits introduced the vulnerable checks themselves. 3c4368da added first-token-only allowlisting and explicitly tested an empty Strict allowlist as allowed; 91f6c2bf created literal substring path blocking; d3480ca9 added exact scripting-runtime regexes that missed intervening or combined flags. Fix 68916c3e replaced those exact designs with metacharacter, glob, argument-aware, and fail-closed checks.

evidence.ai_binding: Each origin commit contains a Claude Co-Authored-By trailer and directly adds a vulnerable check changed by the fix.
